data.body:
*Last updated: 12 November 2026 · By the NM7 Team*

> **Quick answer:** Yes, NM7 is free to start. Building a resume, every ATS-safe template, the ATS scan, the job board, your match score on every job and Manual Apply are free; you need a free account to download your resume. Expert rewrites, Auto Apply and add-on packs are paid. Before a company's jobs reach job seekers, NM7 checks that its email is on its own website's domain and that its GSTIN, CIN or LLPIN is real on the government site. You should still check any job yourself and never pay to get hired.

## Is NM7 really free?

Yes for the things most job seekers need. You pay only if you want a professional to do the work for you or want extra tools.

| Free | Paid (optional) |
|---|---|
| Resume builder (from photos, your own words, an old file or a LinkedIn PDF) | Expert rewrite by a verified professional from your field |
| All ATS-safe templates | LinkedIn pack |
| ATS scan and score (no sign-up) | Tailor pack (tailored resume copies and cover letters) |
| Job board, saved jobs and your match score | Interview pack (practice with feedback) |
| Manual Apply | Auto Apply (NM7 applies for you each morning) |
| Summary writer in 8 Indian languages | Downloads unlocked, extra revisions, express delivery |

A free account is needed to download your resume. Current prices for the paid options are on the [Pricing](https://nm7.si/pricing) page, and prices include GST with a GST invoice.

### What do I get if I pay for an expert?

A verified expert from your field (software, data, finance, marketing, HR, design, operations and more) rewrites your resume. Experts pass a profile review and a test task, and every order is rated. Your first draft arrives within 24–48 hours. If it is late, you get an automatic full refund. If you are not happy, your expert re-does it free first, and then there is a refund review.

### Is it free for colleges and companies?

- **Colleges, job fairs and NGOs:** the Free plan covers one group of up to 50 members and one coordinator, with no payment needed. Paid plans add more members, kiosks and recruiter features. Members can download their own resume free. See [For organizations](https://nm7.si/for-orgs).
- **Companies:** posting jobs is free for verified companies. See [For companies](https://nm7.si/for-companies).

## How does NM7 check companies and jobs?

Fake jobs are one of the biggest risks for freshers in India. NM7 checks every company before its jobs reach students. A company signs up in five steps:

1. **Company details:** legal name, website, category, legal structure, size and industry. Free email services like gmail.com are not accepted as a company website.
2. **Registration:** the company enters its GSTIN (15 characters), CIN (21 characters) or LLPIN, and the NM7 team checks it on the government site.
3. **Email check:** the company email must be on the same domain as the company website.
4. **Team admins:** the company adds the people who can post jobs for it.
5. **Review and submit:** the NM7 team reviews the application before the company can post.

Individual recruiters without a registered business can also sign up. They go through the same review and also give their LinkedIn profile.

Once approved, a company gets a verified badge on its listings.

## How can I check a job myself?

No platform can promise that every job is perfect, so use these checks on any job, on NM7 or anywhere else:

- **Never pay to get a job.** A real employer does not charge for registration, training, a laptop, a uniform or a "security deposit". If anyone asks for money, stop.
- **Check the email domain.** Offers from a real company come from the company's own domain, not a free email address.
- **Look up the company.** Search its registration on the government site (the MCA site for companies, or the GST portal for its GSTIN) and check that the name matches.
- **Be suspicious of "selected without an interview".** Real hiring has at least one conversation.
- **Check the offer letter.** Real letters name the role, salary, joining date, location and a contact person you can verify. See [how to check if an offer letter is fake](https://nm7.si/blog/how-to-check-if-an-offer-letter-is-fake).

If something on NM7 looks wrong, report it through the [contact page](https://nm7.si/contact) and the team will look at it.

## Is my data safe?

Your resume is seen only by you and, if you order one, your assigned expert. Expert files are deleted after delivery, and you can download or delete all your data from Settings. If you use a photo of your Aadhaar or another ID card to fill in your name or address, the ID number itself is removed and never saved or printed.

## FAQ

### Is NM7 free to use?

Yes. The resume builder, all templates, the ATS scan, the job board, your match score and Manual Apply are free. A free account is needed to download. Expert rewrites, Auto Apply and add-on packs are paid.

### Does NM7 charge job seekers to apply for jobs?

No. Searching, saving and Manual Apply are free. Auto Apply, where NM7 applies for you, is an optional paid feature.

### How does NM7 verify companies?

The company email must be on the company's own website domain, and its GSTIN, CIN or LLPIN is checked on the government site. The NM7 team reviews every company before its jobs go live.

### What happens if my expert rewrite is late?

Your first draft arrives within 24–48 hours. If it is late, you get an automatic full refund.

### Should I ever pay for a job I found online?

No. Real employers do not charge job seekers for registration, training or a deposit. If anyone asks for money, it is almost certainly a scam.

## Final thoughts

Use the free tools first; most people never need to pay. And whatever site you find a job on, check the company and never pay to be hired.

Expert rewrites, Auto Apply and add-on packs (LinkedIn, Tailor, Interview) are paid; prices are on the Pricing page and include GST.
An expert's first draft arrives within 24–48 hours; late delivery means an automatic full refund.
NM7 checks that a company's email is on its own website domain and that its GSTIN, CIN or LLPIN is real before its jobs go live.
Never pay anyone to get a job, on NM7 or anywhere else.
